gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-barlow: Stencil-cut and loud: Balsamiq Sans carries a constant stroke with no pinched curves, while Barlow keeps its open, neon-tube lines going. Constant stroke width is the quality that ties them together.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-biz-udgothic: Balsamiq Sans draws every curve and straight at a single width. BIZ UDGothic follows in sans-serif with a touch more contrast and a wide channel into every bowl, so the heading's flatness feels deliberate.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-bpmf-huninn: Balsamiq Sans holds one constant weight through its stencil-cut channel, and Bpmf Huninn continues in sans-serif with a single-weight outline feel. Weight that never swells is what links them.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-bpmf-zihi-kai-st: Bpmf Zihi Kai Std keeps its counters open to the outside, with a restrained swell in its curves. Bpmf Zihi Kai Std gives the uniform-stroke Balsamiq Sans a gentler partner beneath.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-catamaran: Catamaran has curvy letters that feel unclamped, with low contrast. Balsamiq Sans is best at bold, spaghetti-like, same-width display lines, while Catamaran is best at easygoing, gently curved text.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-commissioner: Expressive and stencil-cut, Balsamiq Sans holds a constant weight and never pinches a curve. Commissioner follows in sans-serif, smooth to read, with no clogged curves and a steady line throughout.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-el-messiri: Clean lines, two ways: Balsamiq Sans holds strokes as constant as bent wire. El Messiri is best at the mild swell of a worn felt marker, with a wide opening in its c.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-elms-sans: Modern and unfussy, Elms Sans takes the lower stage under a loud heading. Balsamiq Sans and Elms Sans both keep a constant line weight, which is the quality that links them.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-encode-sans-sc: Encode Sans SC keeps its terminals in a shallow curl with a wide gap. Encode Sans SC is best at low-contrast reading, while Balsamiq Sans is best at curves and straights sharing a single width.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-fahkwang: Fahkwang reads with a faint nib-pressure shimmer across its rounds. Balsamiq Sans is best at arches that match their stems, while Fahkwang is best at medium-contrast curves that finish before they close.
